INDEPENDENT STUDY · KOREAN PDFs

Classiq QAE Onboarding Series

Study the quantum principles and mathematics needed to turn a customer’s question into a computational problem. This independent Korean series connects problem specifications, states and observables with measurement and entanglement, using PDFs with derivations, exercises and worked answers.

L001–L004 · 4 units · 81 PDF pages

Reading order

Read L001 through L004 in order. Each PDF contains the full derivations, exercises, worked answers and glossary. This independently written Korean course uses QAE to mean Quantum Application Engineer. It is separate from official Classiq training and the Classiq webinar replay notes.

L001 · 2026-11-01 · 25 pages · Korean

Problem specifications and first checks

Specify the desired result through inputs, outputs and tolerances, then compare the eigenvalues of a two-level model with the energy expectation of a variational state.

L002 · 2026-11-03 · 20 pages · Korean

Complex vectors, bases and tensor products

Learn complex inner products and changes of basis, then construct two-qubit states with tensor products. Distinguish a change of coordinates from a change of state.

L003 · 2026-11-05 · 19 pages · Korean

Observables, Pauli operators and unitaries

Study an energy matrix as an observable and use it to construct unitary time evolution. Examine Euler and Trotter approximation errors with small matrices.

L004 · 2026-11-07 · 17 pages · Korean

Density matrices, measurement and entanglement

Quantum states can differ even when one measurement basis gives the same probabilities. Learn density matrices and partial traces, then distinguish a Bell state from a classical mixture through correlations and an entanglement witness.

Sources and publication scope

The public editions preserve 77 original educational pages and add one disclosure page per unit, giving 81 pages. Personalized context and file-launch actions were removed. Previously published PDF bytes and original page numbers are preserved.

The original source ZIPs for L001–L003 were not retrieved. L004 has local authoring records, which are not republished in this bundle. The original validation suites, including L004's 50 checks, were not independently rerun for this archive update. The supplementary script checks 20 finite-matrix conditions from L001–L003 using the Python standard library, with a Frobenius-norm Trotter comparison. No Classiq SDK, synthesis, QPU or molecular/DFT experiment was run.
